decisions.title: Inherit the SDD harness (Alt-C) from multi-agent-research-system
LangGraph StateGraph with a deterministic Leader (no LLM-driven transitions)
Isolated roles (research / fact-auditing / synthesis) with curated context
Qdrant primary + ChromaDB for tests behind a VectorStore protocol
bge-small-en-v1.5 (inherited) vs e5 multilingual (default: the vault mixes EN/ES)
Audit loop bounded at 3 iterations with degraded-confidence flag
Context compaction: sliding window 5 + summary every 10 turns
Tavily web search with backoff — SUPERSEDED by ADR-007 (poor results in practice)
MLflow file-based with metrics.jsonl fallback, sanitized keys and SHA-256 hashes
Structural graph layer is deterministic (Obsidian wikilinks, folders, tags), never LLM-extracted
Parameterized Cypher tools first; Text2Cypher validated, read-only, LIMIT, timeout
Vault mounted read-only; writes only to RESEARCH_OUTPUT_DIR; edits are suggested, never applied
Tools exposed as MCP servers (vault, graph, web, scholar, code)
External content is data, never instructions (delimiting + Prompt Guard in P0)
Neo4j (Cypher, GDS, vector index) as the graph database
Self-hosted multi-provider search: SearXNG + Crawl4AI/trafilatura + arXiv + OpenAlex + PyPI + GitHub, RRF fusion and local reranking; Exa optional
All LLM calls through llm-gateway (P0)
Vault excerpts reach cloud models only with VAULT_CLOUD_CONSENT=true (enabled by the user, 2026-10-06); exclusions + Presidio
Durable execution with the LangGraph Postgres checkpointer
Human approval (LangGraph interrupt) before writing any note
Hexagonal core (researchcore: domain + ports), shared researchadapters, services as composition roots; enforced by import-linter
Ingest watcher runs on the host with watchdog's native observer; polling observer opt-in for containers
Neo4j/Qdrant consistency by write order: vectors first, Note.hash as commit marker, startup reconcile
Embeddings: multilingual-e5-small (ONNX export, fastembed custom model, local), passage/query prefixes
